verdict.rationale: The axis applies: an email marketing platform with an API could offer batch or bulk operations. However, the evidence only documents single-item API actions, such as creating one contact or sending one campaign, plus a whole-account export. That export is a data-download feature, not a bulk-operation capability. No batch endpoint or bulk edit, delete, or update across many items is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
